known_event_accuracy_scope: pX/v primary/all group-mean absolute errors; not per-action classification accuracy
group_order: indices 0..5 follow the sorted group order of the sealed bank-major metrics
group_nrmse_status: UNKNOWN unless group energy was provided by the bound raw audit

raw_group_audit.scope: only configurations explicitly present in the independent raw group audit

cost_scope: each packet, C1 supplement, known-event ledger and unit freeze counted once; shared measurement is not charged per model
timing_scope: packet wall_seconds and freeze fit_seconds are recorded wallclock components, not isolated CPU timings; ledger timers may overlap and are not summed into stage walltime
integrity_scope: hashes of consumed files verified against COMPLETE stage manifest; raw predictions/oracles are not recomputed by this script
